title: gethealthreturns200whenserviceishealthy
description: Verify that GET /health returns HTTP 200 with a status indicating the API is healthy when the service and dependencies are operational.

title: postapiauthregistercreatesnewuserwithvalidinput
description: Test POST /api/auth/register with valid fullName, email, phone, and password creates a new user account with status EmailUnverified and returns 201 with userId and email.

title: postapiauthregisterreturns400forinvalidormissingfields
description: Test POST /api/auth/register with missing or invalid fields returns HTTP 400 validation error.

title: postapiauthregisterreturns409forduplicateemail
description: Test POST /api/auth/register with an email that already exists returns HTTP 409 conflict error.

title: postapiauthrequestverificationcodeissuescodeforregisteredemail
description: Test POST /api/auth/request-verification-code with a registered email returns 200 confirmation message and logs the 6-digit code via the stub email sender.

title: postapiauthrequestverificationcodereturns404forunknownemail
description: Test POST /api/auth/request-verification-code with an unknown email returns HTTP 404 no account found.

title: postapiauthverifyemailactivatesaccountwithvalidcode
description: Test POST /api/auth/verify-email with a registered email and valid 6-digit code activates the account (status changes to Active) and returns 200.

title: postapiauthverifyemailreturns400forinvalidorexpiredcode
description: Test POST /api/auth/verify-email with invalid, expired, or already-used code returns HTTP 400 verification failure.

title: postapiauthloginauthenticatesverifieduserandsetscookie
description: Test POST /api/auth/login with verified email and correct password returns 200 with user details and sets the erp_auth httpOnly session cookie.

title: postapiauthforgotpasswordissuesresetcodeforregisteredemail
description: Test POST /api/auth/forgot-password with a registered email returns 200 confirmation message and logs the 6-digit reset code via the stub email sender.
